findings.title: F4 production-arm test cluster S1+S3a+S3b+S3c (18 of 34 tests) exercise trait surface in isolation — bodies do NOT drive production wiring through install_plugin / delegate_capability / admit_write_chain entry points; would-FAIL-on-revert signal unmet per pim-18 §3.6f
findings.body: Per CLAUDE.md baked-in #18 + pim-18 §3.6f SUBSTANTIVE-arm-not-SHAPE discipline: the per-arm body must exercise the production wiring + assert an observable consequence + carry a would-FAIL-if-no-op'd signal. The R6 R1 L13 lens (5cc41cba) explicitly flagged the asserted-OPPOSITE-of-its-name antipattern (the `default_builder_installs_substantive_production_rechecker_not_noop` → `noop_rechecker_admit_everything_is_security_r1_1_would_fail_baseline` rename); the F4 cluster re-introduces a variant of this antipattern. §3.5n ground-truth-verified at HEAD 3c80546f: (1) S3b arm 1 `delegate_capability_surfaces_plugin_per_delegation_denied_code` (L69-77) — NAME claims `delegate_capability` boundary exercise but body only asserts `ErrorCode::PluginPerDelegationDenied.as_str() == "E_PLUGIN_PER_DELEGATION_DENIED"`; if the engine_caps.rs:574 wiring were reverted, the test still PASSES; (2) S3b arm 5 `check_per_delegation_is_callable_on_arc_dyn_capability_policy` (L125-130) — body comment claims `Reverting the wiring would cause the hook to be silently skipped — surface code drift via the type-shape assertion` but the actual assertion `policy.check_per_delegation(...).is_ok()` exercises the trait default through `NoAuthBackend`, NOT through delegate_capability; (3) S3a arm 1 `check_install_consent_observes_invocation_count` (L52-65) — NAME says `observes_invocation_count` (implies count-through-install_plugin) but body calls `policy.check_install_consent(&hash, did)` directly TWICE; revert of plugin_lifecycle.rs:960 wiring → test still passes; (4) S3a arm 6 `install_consent_hook_fires_before_cap_cascade_documented` (L159) — empty body, comment-only `forensic anchor`; (5) S3c arm 1 `inverted_panic_policy_admits_via_check_write_with_audience` (L70-79) — Δv3-3 invert-the-panic pattern is design-sound but the test calls `policy.check_write_with_audience(&ctx)` DIRECTLY; the document comment claims `the integration arms below (which exercise the 4 production sites end-to-end via real engine puts) can rely on it` BUT THERE ARE NO SUCH INTEGRATION ARMS in this file — the panic-policy is not actually mounted into a real engine put-path; a revert at engine.rs:1421 still passes; (6) S1 arm 1 `create_node_admits_under_default_noop_validator` (L57-65) substantive (real engine put) — POSITIVE arm coverage but the negative arm (rejecting validator wired through engine + assertion the typed error surfaces) is missing; the rejecting-validator policy `RejectingValidator` is defined at L36-49 but never mounted into the engine via `set_write_boundary_chain_validator` + driven through a put. The strong substantive end-to-end pattern DOES exist at the sibling `crates/benten-platform-foundation/tests/r6fp_a_plugin_trust_blocker_closures.rs` (drives `install_plugin` end-to-end through `r6fp_a_arch_r6_r1_5_consenting_user_mismatch_surfaces_typed_consenting_user_code` etc.); F4 test files reference that as the integration anchor in comments but do not compose with it.
findings.proposed_fix_shape: Augment each named arm with a substantive production-wiring exercise: (a) S1 arm 6/7 — mount the `RejectingValidator` via `set_write_boundary_chain_validator` + attempt a real `engine.create_node` with a chain anchor → assert typed `WriteBoundaryChainNotUserRooted`; (b) S3a arm 1 — invoke `install_plugin` end-to-end with `DenyAllInstallConsent` mounted in `InstallPorts.policy` → assert typed `PluginInstallConsentDenied`; (c) S3b arm 1 — invoke `delegate_capability` end-to-end with a `CapabilityPolicy` whose `check_per_delegation` denies → assert typed `PluginPerDelegationDenied`; (d) S3c arm 1 — mount `InvertedPanicPolicy` into an engine + drive a put through `apply_atrium_merge` row-path (or `engine_diagnostics.rs:85` transaction commit hook) → would-FAIL on revert via real panic at the production site. Each augmented arm closes the would-FAIL-on-revert gap that pim-18 §3.6f mandates. Alternative (lighter touch): rename the existing arms to honest acknowledged-shape names (`*_typed_code_exists_at_error_catalog`, `*_trait_method_is_callable_on_arc_dyn`) + add a single `*_end_to_end_via_install_plugin_would_fail_if_wiring_reverted` arm per file that does the substantive drive (5 new tests total). The lighter-touch path preserves the per-finding §3.6b sub-rule-4 granularity while closing the SHAPE-not-SUBSTANCE gap; preferred orchestrator path per agent-economics + the existing `r6fp_a_plugin_trust_blocker_closures.rs` precedent.

findings.title: F4 S1 arm 3 + S3c arm 3 const-tautology workspace-walker pattern — `assert_eq!(EXPECTED_X_SITES, X)` against the const itself; would NOT catch a new production WRITE entry point landing without admit_write_chain wiring
findings.body: S1 arm 3 `workspace_walker_audit_thirteen_admit_write_chain_call_sites` declares `const EXPECTED_WRITE_SITES_PER_F1_PATH_A: usize = 13;` then `assert_eq!(EXPECTED_WRITE_SITES_PER_F1_PATH_A, 13);`. This is a tautology — the assertion compares the const to its own literal value. Per pim-18 §3.6f the body must carry a would-FAIL-if-no-op'd signal; here, no operation could cause the assertion to fail (the lhs is the const, the rhs is the const's literal). The doc comment claims 'Adding a new WRITE entry point requires bumping this count + adding the new site's per-arm coverage to this test file' — but the test does not actually walk source files; it asserts a constant. The substantive forward-protection would be a `fs::read_to_string` walk of `crates/benten-engine/src/*.rs` counting `admit_write_chain(` occurrences and asserting the count matches the const. The `for_test_symbols_are_feature_gated.rs` scanner pattern is the precedent for how to do this right. S3c arm 3 `workspace_walker_audit_four_check_write_with_audience_sites` has the identical antipattern (L106-109). §3.5n verified: `grep -rn 'admit_write_chain(' crates/benten-engine/src/` returns 14 hits (13 production + 1 def); `grep -rn 'check_write_with_audience(' crates/benten-engine/src/` returns 5 (4 production + 1 trait def in benten-caps after `use`-resolution). The actual production counts match the constants — so semantically the pins agree at HEAD — but the test mechanism is shape-only.
findings.proposed_fix_shape: Convert each arm to a real source-walker per the `for_test_symbols_are_feature_gated.rs` precedent: read `crates/benten-engine/src/*.rs` files; count `admit_write_chain(` (or `check_write_with_audience(`) occurrences excluding the `pub(crate) fn admit_write_chain(` definition site; assert the count matches the const. ~30 LOC per arm. ALTERNATIVE (lighter): rename the arms to honest acknowledged-shape names (`*_documented_call_site_count_constant_for_reviewer_check`) + add a single workspace-walker arm per file that does the real grep. Lighter path acknowledges the const-doc role explicitly + adds the substantive check separately.

findings.title: Same-attack-class sibling missing for L3 audience_pubkey: tf3b_scope_substitution_post_sign_rejected.rs covers scope-swap but NO sibling pin covers audience_pubkey-swap; L3 R6 R1 MAJOR confirmed same-attack-class but the test pin was only added for scope half (depth-disciplines augmentation 2026-05-24 PM)
files: crates/benten-caps/src/authorization_grant.rs:267 (audience_pubkey field pub + outside binding_message at L390-425)
docs/V1-FROZEN-INTERFACE-DEFERRED.md:516-534 (Row D-15c documents the audience_pubkey defense-in-depth gap — Phase-4-Meta-Composing deferral)
findings.body: §3.5n ground-truth-verified at HEAD 3c80546f: (1) `binding_message()` at authorization_grant.rs:390-425 commits 5 segments: domain_tag || ucan_bytes || km_bytes || audience_cid_bytes || scope_len_u32 || scope_bytes. The `audience_pubkey: Option<Vec<u8>>` field at L267 is NOT one of those segments — it's serialized OUTSIDE binding_sig coverage. (2) tf3b_scope_substitution_post_sign_rejected.rs covers exactly ONE swap-mutable-pub-field pin (scope at L70-82); the analogous audience_pubkey swap-mutable-pub-field test pin DOES NOT EXIST — `grep -rn 'with_swapped_audience_pubkey\|audience_pubkey.*swap\|tampered.*audience_pubkey'` returns ZERO matches across crates/. (3) Row D-15c at V1-FROZEN-INTERFACE-DEFERRED.md:516 documents the gap as 'defense-in-depth promotion, not a v1-beta security gap (a cooperating attacker who forges audience_pubkey still cannot pass binding_sig verification)' — the v1-beta posture is that audience_cid bound via binding_sig provides the audience binding; audience_pubkey is convenience. **But this still leaves a regression-defense gap**: if a future refactor accidentally STARTED relying on `grant.audience_pubkey` instead of `grant.audience_binding` at the validator boundary (or if a future PR added a new validator surface that consults audience_pubkey without re-checking against binding_sig), there is NO regression test pin that would FAIL. This is the same-attack-class siblings pattern: when L3 finds one swap-mutable-pub-field outside binding_message + adds a substantive pin for that field, the §3.6j sweep-completeness self-verify discipline mandates auditing ALL other swap-mutable-pub-fields in the same struct + adding parallel pins (or DEFER-NAMED-NOW to a row tracking the missing pins). Row D-15c covers the FIELD's defense-in-depth promotion (Option→non-Option + audience_pubkey-folded-into-binding-msg), but it does NOT name a regression test pin for the v1-beta posture (preserving the audience_cid-via-binding_sig load-bearing property). Per L3's own discipline carried over to L13: the test-pin sibling is missing.
findings.proposed_fix_shape: Path A (lighter, ~15 LOC): add a sibling test `audience_pubkey_substitution_does_not_widen_via_audience_binding_check_at_v1_beta` in tf3b_scope_substitution_post_sign_rejected.rs: issue a grant with audience X (pubkey + cid); tamper grant.audience_pubkey to attacker's pubkey while leaving audience_binding=X.cid intact; call `verify_binding(X.cid)` — MUST still return Ok (audience_binding is the load-bearing check + audience_pubkey is not bound at v1-beta + binding_sig still verifies; the test PINS the posture). Then assert (via grep-test or const) that `binding_message()` does NOT include audience_pubkey at v1-beta — so a future maintainer who 'fixes' the perceived gap by folding audience_pubkey into binding_message will BREAK this test, forcing the refactor to coordinate with Row D-15c closure. Path B (HARD RULE 12 clause-(b)): extend Row D-15c at V1-FROZEN-INTERFACE-DEFERRED.md:516 with an explicit sub-clause naming the missing test pin destination (`crates/benten-caps/tests/tf3b_scope_substitution_post_sign_rejected.rs::audience_pubkey_substitution_test`) as the Phase-4-Meta-Composing closure shape. Path A preferred (~5min orchestrator-direct; preserves v1-beta posture explicitly; closes the §3.6j sweep-completeness sibling gap).

findings.title: F4 S3c arm 5 `ucan_grounded_excluded_per_delta_v3_7` is a comment-only forensic-anchor test with NO assertion body — anti-pattern for #[test] discoverability + #[ignore] semantics
findings.body: S3c arm 5 declares `#[test] fn ucan_grounded_excluded_per_delta_v3_7() { // No assertion body — the exclusion is documented by the comment above + the sweep-enumeration arm's count of 4 (not 4+N where N is the ucan_grounded test sites). }`. A `#[test]` with no assertions registers as PASS-by-vacuity in nextest output, which is confusing review signal. Same antipattern appears at S3a arm 6 `install_consent_hook_fires_before_cap_cascade_documented` (L159-179) — empty body, comment-only forensic anchor. Both are forensic-anchor cites that legitimately belong in DOC SPACE (module-level `//!` or test-file `//!` headers), NOT as #[test] declarations. Per discoverability + nextest test-count discipline + the existing `noop_default_returns_not_applicable_for_every_chain` precedent (which has a substantive `assert_eq!` body): a forensic anchor that asserts nothing should not be a #[test].
findings.proposed_fix_shape: Convert the 2 zero-assertion `#[test]` arms to either (a) module-level `//!` documentation prose (preferred — preserves the forensic note + removes the misleading test count); (b) substantive assertion bodies (S3c arm 5 → assert by grep that `ucan_grounded.rs::check_write(` calls are inside `#[cfg(test)]` per Δv3-7 contract; S3a arm 6 → integration test that demonstrates the pre-cap-cascade ordering via mounted consent-deny + assertion that no partial-grant residue appears). Path (a) ~3min sed; Path (b) ~30 LOC each. Path (a) preferred to avoid scope creep + per HARD RULE 12 clause-(b) BELONGS-NAMED-NOW for the ordering-substantive arm (G-COMP-1 destination + named row in the consolidated f4-r6-fp followup row, if one is opened).

findings.title: Same-attack-class sibling missing for L3 audience_pubkey: tf3b_scope_substitution_post_sign_rejected.rs covers scope-swap but NO sibling pin covers audience_pubkey-swap; L3 R6 R1 MAJOR confirmed same-attack-class but the test pin was only added for scope half

findings.body: §3.5n ground-truth-verified at HEAD 3c80546f: (1) `binding_message()` at authorization_grant.rs:390-425 commits 5 segments: domain_tag || ucan_bytes || km_bytes || audience_cid_bytes || scope_len_u32 || scope_bytes. The `audience_pubkey: Option<Vec<u8>>` field at L267 is NOT one of those segments — it's serialized OUTSIDE binding_sig coverage. (2) tf3b_scope_substitution_post_sign_rejected.rs covers exactly ONE swap-mutable-pub-field pin (scope at L70-82); the analogous audience_pubkey swap-mutable-pub-field test pin DOES NOT EXIST — `grep -rn 'with_swapped_audience_pubkey\|audience_pubkey.*swap\|tampered.*audience_pubkey'` returns ZERO matches across crates/. (3) Row D-15c at V1-FROZEN-INTERFACE-DEFERRED.md:516 documents the gap as 'defense-in-depth promotion, not a v1-beta security gap (a cooperating attacker who forges audience_pubkey still cannot pass binding_sig verification)' — the v1-beta posture is that audience_cid bound via binding_sig provides the audience binding; audience_pubkey is convenience. **But this still leaves a regression-defense gap**: if a future refactor accidentally STARTED relying on `grant.audience_pubkey` instead of `grant.audience_binding` at the validator boundary (or if a future PR added a new validator surface that consults audience_pubkey without re-checking against binding_sig), there is NO regression test pin that would FAIL. This is the same-attack-class siblings pattern: when L3 finds one swap-mutable-pub-field outside binding_message + adds a substantive pin for that field, the §3.6j sweep-completeness self-verify discipline mandates auditing ALL other swap-mutable-pub-fields in the same struct + adding parallel pins (or DEFER-NAMED-NOW to a row tracking the missing pins). Row D-15c covers the FIELD's defense-in-depth promotion (Option→non-Option + audience_pubkey-folded-into-binding-msg), but it does NOT name a regression test pin for the v1-beta posture (preserving the audience_cid-via-binding_sig load-bearing property). Per L3's own discipline carried over to L13: the test-pin sibling is missing.
findings.proposed_fix_shape: Path A (lighter, ~15 LOC): add a sibling test `audience_pubkey_substitution_does_not_widen_via_audience_binding_check_at_v1_beta` in tf3b_scope_substitution_post_sign_rejected.rs: issue a grant with audience X (pubkey + cid); tamper grant.audience_pubkey to attacker's pubkey while leaving audience_binding=X.cid intact; call `verify_binding(X.cid)` — MUST still return Ok (audience_binding is the load-bearing check + audience_pubkey is not bound at v1-beta + binding_sig still verifies; the test PINS the posture). Then assert (via grep-test or const) that `binding_message()` does NOT include audience_pubkey at v1-beta — so a future maintainer who 'fixes' the perceived gap by folding audience_pubkey into binding_message will BREAK this test, forcing the refactor to coordinate with Row D-15c closure. Path B (HARD RULE 12 clause-(b)): extend Row D-15c at V1-FROZEN-INTERFACE-DEFERRED.md:516 with an explicit sub-clause naming the missing test pin destination (`crates/benten-caps/tests/tf3b_scope_substitution_post_sign_rejected.rs::audience_pubkey_substitution_test`) as the Phase-4-Meta-Composing closure shape. Path A preferred (~5min orchestrator-direct; preserves v1-beta posture explicitly; closes the §3.6j sweep-completeness sibling gap).
